ai.title: CLI usage refresh moves to TanStack Query
ai.summary: The CLI `/usage` command and banner now fetch quota data via a new `useUsageQuery` hook built on TanStack Query, replacing the direct `fetchAndUpdateUsage` calls. This change centralizes state management, introduces a 30-second stale time, and prevents redundant fetches when the banner is hidden or data is fresh. The migration affects `cli/src/hooks/use-usage-query.ts`, `cli/src/components/usage-banner.tsx`, and `cli/src/commands/usage.ts`, removing the manual error handling from the command in favor of query state.

eli5.text: When you run the usage command in the CLI, the assistant now shows your quota information through a refreshed system that avoids making the same request over and over, even if the banner is hidden and shown again. The usage banner you see will update automatically when you view it, and the assistant no longer needs a separate step to handle errors when fetching your data, since the new system manages that quietly in the background.

Thresholds defined as `HIGH_CREDITS_THRESHOLD` (1000) and `MEDIUM_CREDITS_THRESHOLD` (100) map to `theme.success`, `theme.warning`, and `theme.error` respectively. Null balances default to warning. This change is scoped strictly to the CLI surface.

eli5.text: When you use the command-line tool and look at your account's credit balance, the text and border around it now change color to show how much credit you have left. If your balance is 1,000 or more, the banner appears in a positive color; if it drops below 1,000 but stays above 100, it switches to a cautionary color; and if it falls below 100 or is missing entirely, it turns to an alert color. Anyone using the command-line version today will see these color shifts automatically when they view their usage.

ai.title: Fix initialPrompt auto-submit in CLI chat input
ai.summary: Removed premature cleanup of the auto-submit timeout in `use-chat-input.ts`. The `setTimeout` handle was returned from the effect, causing `clearTimeout` to run on unmount or dependency change before the 100ms delay elapsed, preventing `initialPrompt` from reaching `onSubmitPrompt`. The fix deletes the return statement, ensuring the prompt submission completes. Affects CLI hook behavior only.

eli5.text: When you start a chat with a prompt already filled in, it now sends that message correctly instead of losing it. The program had a short delay to let everything load before sending, but that delay was being canceled too early, so the message never went through. Now the delay completes and your pre-written prompt is actually submitted.

The change updates `cli/src/chat.tsx` to pass `cursorPosition` to `useSuggestionEngine`, and modifies `parseMentionContext` in `cli/src/hooks/use-suggestion-engine.ts` to analyze only the text up to the current cursor index.

eli5.text: When you're typing a message and you insert an @ symbol to tag a file, the file suggestions now appear no matter where your cursor is in the text line. Previously, the suggestion menu would only open if the @ was at the very end of what you'd typed, so adding an @ or editing earlier in the message wouldn't show file options. Now the system checks the text up to your cursor's exact position instead of just the end of the line, so you get suggestions wherever you pause after typing an @. This change is already live in the CLI.

ai.title: CLI 1.0.522 release with usage TanStack Query, dynamic banner colors
ai.summary: Ships Freebuff CLI 1.0.522 bundling all user-facing work since 1.0.521. The CLI `/usage` command and usage banner now fetch quota data via a new `useUsageQuery` hook built on TanStack Query, replacing direct `fetchAndUpdateUsage` calls with 30-second stale-time deduplication and removal of manual store sync in `chat-store.ts`. The `UsageBanner` component in `cli/src/components/usage-banner.tsx` now sets border/text colors dynamically from `HIGH_CREDITS_THRESHOLD` (1000) and `MEDIUM_CREDITS_THRESHOLD` (100) mappings to `theme.success`/`theme.warning`/`theme.error`. `@codebuff/sdk` adds typed `AuthenticationError`/`NetworkError` classes plus retry config constants (`MAX_RETRIES_PER_MESSAGE`, 1s-8s backoff bounds) exported via `index.ts`. Additional fixes: `initialPrompt` auto-submit timeout cleanup in `use-chat-input.ts`, cursor-position-aware `@`-menu triggering in `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `.` descriptions for root-level files in `use-suggestion-engine.ts`, and a new dismissible `AnnouncementBanner` (`cli/src/components/announcement-banner.tsx`) for the Codebuff UI update with `/feedback` prompt and revert command `npm install -g codebuff@legacy`.
ai.evidence: Diff shows cli/release/package.json version bump from 1.0.521 to 1.0.522, +1/-1 lines, commit metadata Category CLI, nature release-bump. Analysis notes list 13 updates since 1.0.521.

eli5.text: This release brings web search fixes so the CLI can actually authenticate search requests, refreshes the usage system to load credit data faster and more reliably via a centralized data hook, and adds color-coded credit banners that turn green, yellow, or red based on your remaining balance. The usage display now uses a modern data-fetching system that avoids duplicate requests when the banner is hidden or data is fresh, while the @mention menu works anywhere in your input line instead of only at the end. A new announcement banner lets users know about the Codebuff UI update and offers a one-command revert option (npm install -g codebuff@legacy), and the SDK now ships with smarter retry logic and typed error classes to handle network glitches and authentication failures more gracefully. Together these changes mean fewer surprise authentication errors, clearer credit-status visibility, faster usage data loading, and more resilient behavior when network hiccups occur.

ai.title: Add useTimeout hook for key-based timeout management
ai.summary: New `useTimeout` hook introduced in `cli/src/hooks/use-timeout.ts` to manage multiple timeouts via unique keys. Mechanism mimics TanStack Query's key-based API, ensuring automatic cleanup of all active timeouts upon component unmount. Scope limited to CLI hooks; provides `setTimeout` and `clearTimeout` methods that prevent memory leaks and handle timeout replacement. Key detail: scheduling a new timeout with an existing key automatically cancels the previous instance before setting the new one.

eli5.text: The CLI tool now has better control over timed actions that used to cause glitches. A new system lets it schedule and replace timers by name, so if the same timed task is started again, the old one is canceled instead of piling up and potentially leaking memory. It also cleans up all remaining timers automatically when it closes, preventing leftover actions from running after you're done. This makes background tasks in the command-line interface more reliable and responsive, especially during rapid updates or shutdown.

ai.title: Fix readsubtree token score remapping for subdirectories
ai.summary: Corrects `read_subtree` handler to remap `fileTokenScores` keys when building results for nested directories. Previously, token scores were looked up using absolute paths while `printFileTreeWithTokens` generated relative paths from the subtree root, causing score mismatches. The fix clones the directory nodes, calculates a prefix based on `outPath`, and strips parent path segments to align score keys with the printed tree structure. Changes are contained in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/handlers/tool/read-subtree.ts`.

eli5.text: When you asked the assistant to show you the files inside a subfolder (not the whole project), it used to look up each file's token cost using the full project path, but the helper that prints the tree built paths starting from the subfolder. That mismatch meant some files' token costs didn't line up with their names in the printed tree. The fix remaps those token cost entries to use the same relative paths the printed tree displays, so the token counts now match the file names shown when browsing a subfolder. It's already live today and only affects subtree views.
